answer: Reaching eligibility takes 79 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. The nectar register is checked at draw time, meadow lists the eligible set, and ember seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 79 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. That is 5 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
